hpi_durata.frammento: An HPI visa lasts for 2 years. If you have a PhD or other doctoral qualification, it will last for 3 years.

hpi_5anni.frammento: To apply, you must have been awarded a qualification by an eligible university in the last 5 years.

hpi_limite.frammento: There is a yearly limit on applications for this visa. The application year runs between 1 November and 31 October.

hpi_mese.frammento: Check the list of eligible universities for the month and year you were awarded your qualification

hpi_classifiche.frammento: The list of eligible universities is based on rankings of universities from around the world.

hpi_livello.frammento: Your qualification must be at the same level as: a UK bachelor’s degree a UK postgraduate degree a UK PhD or doctorate

hpi_ecctis_uni.frammento: Ecctis will not check if your university is eligible.

hpi_offerta.frammento: You do not need to have a job offer to apply.

hpi_una_volta.frammento: You can only apply for an HPI visa once.

hpi_proroga.frammento: You cannot extend your HPI visa.

hpi_graduate.frammento: you have already been given a Graduate visa

hpi_ecctis.frammento: pay £252 for Ecctis to check your qualification is valid (this includes VAT)

hpi_ihs.frammento: pay the healthcare surcharge - this is usually £1,035 for each year you’ll be in the UK

hpi_fondi.frammento: you’ll usually need to have at least £1,270 available (unless you’re exempt)

hpi_inglese.frammento: to at least level B2 on the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR) scale

hpi_tempi.frammento: 3 weeks, if you’re outside the UK

hpi_nov2021.frammento: 1 November 2021 to 31 October 2022 UK universities are not eligible.

hpi_rimossa2020.frammento: Removed the High Potential Individual visa: global universities list 2020 as it is outdated.

hpi_5anni_raccolta.frammento: You can apply for the HPI route if you have graduated from an eligible international university in the 5 years immediately before your application.

ttps_durata.frammento: Successful TTPS applicant will normally be granted an initial stay of 36 months (Category A) / 24 months (Categories B and C) on time limitation only without other conditions of stay.

ttps_offerta.frammento: are not required to have secured an offer of employment in the HKSAR upon application

ttps_b.frammento: with at least three years of work experience

ttps_c.frammento: with less than three years of work experience

ttps_quota.frammento: subject to an annual quota which is to be allotted on a first-come, first-served basis (Category C)

ttps_c_locali.frammento: Category C does not apply to those non-local students

ttps_5anni.frammento: Graduation in the past five years is counted by “year of graduation”.

ttps_bachelor.frammento: must be equivalent to the recognised Hong Kong standard of bachelor’s degrees

ttps_rami.frammento: the branch schools, the extension schools or the subsidiary schools, etc., established by the eligible universities will not be accepted

ttps_esclusi.frammento: The TTPS does not apply to nationals of Afghanistan, Cuba and Korea (Democratic People's Republic of).

ttps_tempi.frammento: It normally takes four weeks to process visa/entry permit applications under the TTPS

ttps_verifica.frammento: Applicants are required to submit verification proof issued by a third-party credential verification organisation or the awarding institution

ttps_tassa_domanda.frammento: Principal applicant or Dependant Application fee Note 3 600

ttps_tariffe_dal.frammento: With effect from 11 a.m. on 26 February 2025
